race.title: BAR 1 Betting '2Up Early Payout' Handicap
race.verdict: The consistent DALER looks a very solid proposition having been only narrowly denied over C&D last week and gets the verdict over Exquisite Acclaim , who has rather encouragingly been able to string a couple of positive efforts together. Stable-switcher Jolly Roger merits a second look in the betting. DALER (IRE) EXQUISITE ACCLAIM (IRE) JOLLY ROGER (IRE)
